d: Internship Opportunities – Marketing & Mobile Flutter Development (Unpaid)
Work Arrangement: Marketing Intern (Onsite based on schedule) while Mobile Flutter Inrern (Remote)

Lamdax develops scalable digital solutions that streamline business processes, support data-driven decisions, and enable organizational growth. Working across the computer software space, the team focuses on building practical products and services that help organizations operate more effectively and make smarter decisions.
LamdaX is offering an exciting opportunity for undergraduate students to gain practical experience and develop their professional skills through a six-month internship program.

We are looking for motivated, committed, and enthusiastic students who are eager to learn, contribute to real-world projects, and gain exposure to a professional working environment within a growing technology company.
There are two available internship tracks

Candidates will be asked to select their preferred track when completing the application screening questions. Applicants should choose the track that best matches their academic background, interests, and skills.
q: Currently enrolled as an undergraduate student pursuing a degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
Strong interest in digital marketing, branding, and social media.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Creativity and willingness to contribute new ideas.
Basic understanding of social media platforms and digital marketing concepts.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.
Assist in developing and maintaining cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
Support the implementation of responsive and user-friendly mobile interfaces.
Work with REST APIs and integrate backend services into mobile applications.
Assist in debugging, testing, and troubleshooting application issues.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code.
Collaborate with the development team to implement new features and improvements.
Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to improve code quality.
Follow development guidelines, coding standards, and best practices.
Currently enrolled as an undergraduate student pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
Basic knowledge of programming fundamentals and object-oriented programming (OOP).
Familiarity with Dart and Flutter, or a strong willingness to learn them.
Basic understanding of mobile application development concepts.
Familiarity with Git and version control is a plus.
Basic knowledge of REST APIs and JSON is an advantage.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to learn quickly, accept feedback, and work collaboratively.
Must be currently enrolled as an undergraduate student at a university.
Must be available for a full-time commitment throughout the six-month internship.
Must own a reliable laptop suitable for the selected internship track and be able to depend on it throughout the internship.
Must have a stable internet connection.
Must be comfortable working in a fully remote environment.
Must demonstrate commitment, accountability, willingness to learn, and good communication skills.
r: Assist in developing and executing digital marketing campaigns.
Support social media content planning, creation, and scheduling.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
Assist in identifying target audiences and understanding market trends.
Contribute to content creation for social media platforms and other marketing channels.
Monitor social media performance and assist in preparing marketing reports.
Research new marketing opportunities and suggest creative ideas.
Collaborate with team members on marketing initiatives and campaigns.
Hands-on experience working on real-world projects.
Practical exposure to a professional working environment.
Guidance, mentorship, and constructive feedback from experienced team members.
Opportunities to develop technical or professional skills relevant to your selected track.
Experience collaborating with a remote, cross-functional team.
An opportunity to strengthen your portfolio and build your professional experience.
Work Arrangement: Marketing Intern (Onsite based on schedule) while Mobile Flutter Inrern (Remote)
Equipment: Candidates must provide their own reliable laptops and internet connections.
If you are eager to learn, take on new challenges, and gain practical experience, we encourage you to apply and select the internship track that best suits your interests and background!
